item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
Issued at 12:20 PM 09 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Romblon(SanAgustin, SantaMaria, Alcantara, Odiongan, Calatrava and SanAndres) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Masbate(Claveria, SanPascual) and #Romblon(Romblon) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
